cohort: Forty pregnant women in their third gestational trimester, divided into a Type 1 diabetic group and a control group.
finding: Pregnant women with Type 1 diabetes in their third trimester had a significantly higher International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire Short Form (ICIQ-SF) score compared to non-diabetic controls, indicating increased urinary incontinence.
birth_weight: Newborn weight was registered after delivery, but no specific weight range for inclusion was mentioned.
